premises.text: Therapy often fails a meaningful minority and lacks continuous digital relationship-health tracking

premises.evidence_span: LifeCouple is a platform that allows couples to address relationship challenges in a way that's suitable for their everyday life

premises.text: Positioned to complement therapy and EAP channels rather than replace clinicians
premises.evidence_span: we complement therapy. We do not say that therapy is going to be replaced by technology

value.text: Keep couples together with measurable relationship health
value.evidence_span: This platform will keep us together
